# Subdirectories

* [capabilities](capabilities/index.md) - The library holds a tool for a member and records the loan from pickup to return.
* [journeys](journeys/index.md) - A member reserves a tool and collects it at the desk.

# glossary

* [Glossary](glossary.md) - The terms that the Tool Library uses for its members, tools, and loans.

# vision

* [Vision](vision.md) - A neighbourhood shares tools through one desk, so that a member borrows a tool in place of a purchase.
